summary: Instagram Reels algorithms heavily favor high-retention gameplay loops with native text hooks and seamless audio syncing. Originality and high visual fidelity in 9:16 vertical video continue to outperform recycled or watermarked footage.

formats.name: Punch Zoom Hook
formats.how: Start with an intense gameplay moment, zoom in abruptly on the action at 0.5 seconds, and place bold text over the screen.

formats.name: Instant Replay
formats.how: Show the full-speed play first for shock value, immediately followed by a slow-motion replay capturing the exact frame of impact.

edit_styles.notes: Classic works best for fast COD gunfights; replay is ideal for unbelievable FC27 goals and chaotic GTA 6 stunt physics.

caption_tips: Keep text under 5 words to force viewers to re-watch while reading.
Use niche gaming keywords early in the caption to improve discoverability.
End captions with an open-ended question to drive comment section engagement.
algorithm_updates: Instagram prioritizes original content and penalizes unedited reposts; ensure every clip has unique cuts, custom color grading, or original commentary.
